subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Comparar, com a ajuda do professor, conteúdos, dados e informações de diferentes fontes, levando em conta seus contextos de produção e referências, identificando coincidências, complementaridades e contradições, de forma a poder identificar erros/imprecisões conceituais, compreender e posicionar-se criticamente sobre os conteúdos e informações em questão.

components.description_pt: Comparar quais detalhes dois ou mais autores incluem ou enfatizam em seus relatos do mesmo tema
components.description_en: Compare which details two or more authors include or emphasize in their accounts of the same topic
components.cc_component_description: Compare which details two or more authors include or emphasize in their accounts of the same topic

components.description_pt: Identificar erros ou imprecisões conceituais por meio de consulta cruzada de múltiplas fontes
components.description_en: Identify potential errors or conceptual inaccuracies by cross-referencing multiple sources
components.cc_component_description: Identify conflicting information across multiple sources on the same scientific topic

components.description_pt: Avaliar fontes considerando seus contextos de produção e autoridades referenciadas
components.description_en: Evaluate sources by considering their production contexts and referenced authorities
components.cc_component_description: Identify and evaluate the credibility of sources used to support a claim

components.description_pt: Desenvolver posicionamento crítico analisando complementaridades e contradições entre fontes
components.description_en: Develop a critical stance toward content by analyzing complementarities and contradictions across sources
components.cc_component_description: Resolve contradictions among competing claims by evaluating supporting evidence

cc_matches.description: Compare the point of view of two or more authors for how they treat the same or similar topics, including which details they include and emphasize in their respective accounts.

Synthesize information from a range of sources (e.g., texts, experiments, simulations) into a coherent understanding of a process, phenomenon, or concept, resolving conflicting information when possible.
Support claim(s) with logical reasoning and relevant evidence, using accurate, credible sources and demonstrating an understanding of the topic or text.

Respond thoughtfully to diverse perspectives; synthesize comments, claims, and evidence made on all sides of an issue; resolve contradictions when possible; and determine what additional information or research is required to deepen the investigation or complete the task.
